summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the launch of a Real-Time Structured Receivable Program (SRP) for the point-of-sale industry in Canada and the United States. The program is an AI-enabled enhancement to its existing SRP funding solution, with Financeit as the first large-scale partner. No financial terms, deal consideration, or strategic transaction are involved; this is a routine product launch announcement. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report not triggering any special-situation category. No regulatory clock, advisor, or board recommendation is noted. There is no risk-arb angle or actionable event for special-situations investors. The filing simply reports a business development.
